import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Get top 10 dog breeds

sns.barplot(x='Count', y='Breed', data=breed_counts, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich (2024)', fontsize=14)
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Breed', fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout()
